test.text: Check that the contrast ratio is now 4.58:1.
Ensure the text is readable and not flagged as low contrast.

steps: 1. Add a style attribute to the <b> element.
2. Set color to #394951 (or change background to #bbc6cc).
3. Verify the new contrast ratio is ≥4.5:1.
content.explanation: The bold text has low contrast (3.88:1) against its background, making it hard to read for users with visual impairments. Increasing contrast to at least 4.5:1 meets WCAG 2.2 1.4.3 for normal text.
